描述_EN: around 1730 ceramic handles were introduced to europe from china. knives have been used since prehistoric times, but the history of knives, forks and spoons for eating in europe probably commenced in the fourteenth century, and their use became accepted by the sixteenth century. although cutlers were required by their guilds to be able to make a complete knife, handles of carved ivory, silver, bronze and glass were usually imported or made by specialist craftsmen. ebony, ivory, fish skin, tortoiseshell, amber, bone, horn and shell were all popular for decorating cutlery. this pair of a fork and knife in a later boxwood sheath is italian and made in about 1650-700. until the late seventeenth century it seems to have been common practice for people to carry their own cutlery, often in a leather case.
描述_ZN: 大约在1730年，陶瓷手柄从中国传入欧洲。 刀子从史前时代就开始使用了，但是欧洲的刀子、叉子和勺子吃饭的历史可能开始于十四世纪，它们的使用在十六世纪就被接受了。 虽然行会要求刀匠能够制作一把完整的刀，但象牙、银、青铜和玻璃雕刻的刀柄通常是进口的或由专业工匠制作。 乌木、象牙、鱼皮、玳瑁、琥珀、骨、角和贝壳都是装饰餐具的常用材料。 这对装在后来的黄杨木鞘中的刀叉是意大利的，大约制作于1650-700年。 直到十七世纪末，人们携带自己的餐具似乎是一种普遍的做法，通常是放在一个皮箱里。
